_comment: Copy to servers.json and fill in your own hosts. servers.json is gitignored because it names internal hosts, rooms and rack positions. min_ssh_interval_sec is a hard floor between SSH connection attempts, enforced across processes: campus networks flag a host that opens several SSH connections per second, so never lower it below 2.0.

servers.name: gpu02
servers.note: No DNS record for this host; the literal address is deliberate. pin_address makes the loader refuse a hostname here, so nobody can 'tidy it up' and silently take the host offline.

servers.name: gpu03
servers.note: enabled:false keeps the collector away from a host whose key is not installed yet. Retrying one you cannot authenticate to just feeds its fail2ban.

racks.note: Slots are listed top to bottom, as physically racked.
